text: Amazon Bedrock is a managed AWS service for building generative AI applications using foundation models through APIs.
Retrieval Augmented Generation, or RAG, retrieves relevant documents and provides them as context to a language model.
OpenSearch supports vector search using k-NN indexes and approximate nearest neighbor algorithms such as HNSW.
FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search over dense vectors and supports indexes such as Flat, IVF, and HNSW.
Recall@K measures how many relevant documents are retrieved within the top K results compared with all relevant documents.
Mean Reciprocal Rank evaluates how early the first relevant result appears in a ranked list.
nDCG evaluates ranking quality using graded relevance and discounts documents that appear lower in the result list.
BM25 is a lexical ranking method that scores documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency, and length normalization.
Embeddings convert text into numerical vectors so semantic similarity can be measured using cosine similarity or dot product.
In RAG systems, hallucination can be reduced by grounding generated answers in retrieved source documents.
